spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unripe.
E.
अ neg. and शृत ripe.

m. (-रः)
The juice or essence of the body, lymph, serum, &c.
E.
असृज् blood, and कर what makes.

mf. (-क्पः-क्पा)
A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin of malicious propensities.
E.
असृज् blood, and प who drinks: these demons eat flesh, human or animal.

m. (-तः)
Drops of blood, as from a wound.
E.
असृज् and पात falling.

m. (-वः)
Bleeding, letting blood.
E.
असृज् and आब causing to flow.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Bleeding, who or what takes away blood.
E.
असृज् and श्राविन् what causes to flow.

f. (-रा)
Irregular or excessive menstruation, menorrhagia.
E.
अतृज्, दृ to tear, affix अप्.

f. (-रा)
The skin.
E.
असृज् and धरा what contains: blood-containing; also असृग्धारा.

f. (-रा)
1 The skin.
2 A stream of blood.
E.
असृज् and धारा a stream.

f. (-हा)
A blood vessel.
E.
असृज् and वह what bears.

n. (-णं)
Bleeding.
E.
असृज् and विमाक्षण letting.

n. (-सृक्)
Blood.
E.
अ neg. सृज् to create, क्विप् aff.

mf. (-टः-टी)
A stream of blood.
E.
अ neg. सृप to go, काटः aff.

Undistributed, not presented.
E.
अ neg. सृष्ट created, &c.
